configuration.initialization: Uniform behavioral strategy; CFR zero regrets, fictitious play one uniform prior observation, double oracle one uniform seed strategy per player.
configuration.comparison: Same game, payoff scale, iteration cap, full SPR target, repetitions, deterministic tie handling, and warm-up. CFR certifies its average with two extra best responses every check_every iterations; FP and DO certify their current output at every iteration from the best responses they compute anyway. Iterations have different work; compare time and work counts as well.
configuration.chance: Exact weighted enumeration; no sampling or training seed.

environment.timing: Warmed runs, constructor + solve including exact SPR certificates (CFR: two extra BRs every check_every iterations; FP and DO: free, every iteration, from their own oracle calls); excludes tree construction, post-run independent validation, policy export, and the untimed analysis section. History times include constructor. All repetitions rotate method order.

nonunique.situation: P1 holds G2 and P2 has offered G2/G3
